summary: Standardize and generate language-neutral Twin v1

delivery.outcome: Twin Standard v1 validates one language-neutral protobuf-first all-traits profile and deterministically generates a portable contract and conformance bundle for any language identifier
nonGoals: No generation or execution of provider-specific application code
No modification of any source Twin repository or exported snapshot
No persistent event-store or production connector implementation
No deployment, public visibility, release, merge or secret access
No LLM result can grant authority or replace deterministic validation

architecture.decision: Use a canonical proto3 semantic model plus a declarative all-traits profile; validate CQRS, Event Sourcing, replay, authority and adapter invariants before atomically generating language-neutral contract metadata
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-001 before any stable release; generated bundles remain identifiable by their profile and protobuf hashes

validation.evidence: Positive and negative fixtures enforce CQRS, Event Sourcing, evidence, connector, replay and authority invariants
The canonical profile resolves every declared protobuf message and required service
Every all-traits operation is bound exactly once across CLI, shell, REST and MCP
Mutation tests fail closed with stable TWIN diagnostics
Two fresh generations are byte-identical and an existing destination is never overwritten
Host, Docker and ticket governance pass with no runtime dependencies and five implementation files
